cohort: 6,159 patients with a history of cesarean section undergoing frozen embryo transfer at the CITIC-Xiangya Hospital of Reproduction and Genetics between January 2014 and December 2019.
finding: While hormone replacement therapy for endometrial preparation was associated with a higher early miscarriage rate in women with a history of cesarean section undergoing frozen embryo transfer, this risk was small and did not impact the overall reproductive performance.
